assay: bulk RNA-seq of left tibia (bone tissue), Novogene, Illumina
organism: Rat (male SD, 16 weeks old at start)
sample_inclusion: RNA-seq n = 3 rats per group (Fig. 5 legend); left tibiae
primary_estimand: Effect of 6-week moderate-intensity treadmill exercise vs sedentary control on tibial bone gene expression in adult male rats
planned_contrasts: Exercise vs Ctrl (S3.3.p1; paper: 2076 DEGs, 1552 up / 524 down)

paper_threshold.significance_criterion: not_reported (paper states only the fold-change rule); encoded as no p-value filter

paper_results: 2076 DEGs (1552 up, 524 down); 39 bone-formation genes up incl. Igf1r, Bglap, Sp7, Smad6, Runx2, Ctnnb1, Col1a1, Pth1r (S3.3.p3); qPCR Runx2 up, Rankl/Trap down; GO/KEGG ORA (FDR < 0.05 for terms), GSEA ECM/osteoblast differentiation enriched in exercise
